items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: Did Mr. Carnish ever have any pupils that come to the house after you married him?

ctx.x: Did Mr. Carnish ever have any pupils that come to the house after you married him? Any pupil that learned trombone from you?
No, just them boys used to come there, but them boys with good sizes used to come there with you boys, but I don't know where they went. I don't know where they went.
